# Generated by Booley synth (ADR 0037) -- do not edit.
# Boundary Command Contract: runnable with only the EDA binaries on
# PATH (sv2v/yosys + the configured timing engine); results land as
# files in this directory. BOOLEY_STAGE markers attribute a
# post-mortem log tail to the stage that died.
.POSIX:

all: sta
.PHONY: all yosys sv2v sta

sv2v:
	@echo 'BOOLEY_STAGE: sv2v'
	sv2v -I../syn_demo_0/syn/src/syn_demo_0/rtl/include -DSYNTHESIS ../syn_demo_0/syn/src/syn_demo_0/rtl/pkg.sv ../syn_demo_0/syn/src/syn_demo_0/rtl/dut.sv -w sv2v_converted.v > sv2v.log 2>&1 || { rc=$$?; tail -n 40 sv2v.log; exit $$rc; }

yosys: sv2v
	@echo 'BOOLEY_STAGE: yosys'
	yosys -s synth.ys > yosys.log 2>&1 || { rc=$$?; tail -n 40 yosys.log; exit $$rc; }

sta: yosys
	@echo 'BOOLEY_STAGE: sta'
	@sta_bin=''; \
	if command -v sta >/dev/null 2>&1; then sta_bin=sta; \
	elif command -v opensta >/dev/null 2>&1; then sta_bin=opensta; fi; \
	if [ -n "$$sta_bin" ]; then \
	  "$$sta_bin" run_opensta.tcl > sta.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 sta.log; echo 'WARNING: OpenSTA failed; timing unavailable'; }; \
	else echo 'WARNING: OpenSTA requested but neither sta nor opensta is on PATH'; fi;
